items.hook: The Three Roads, published in 1948, was the fourth novel by Kenneth Millar, and the final one using his real name before he started writing detective novels, ultimately using his later pseudonym, Ross Macdonald.
items.body: In its use of psychological motifs and a Californian setting, The Three Roads anticipates Macdonald's later fiction. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Callirhoe is an Ancient Greek novel by Chariton, that exists in one somewhat unreliable manuscript from the 13th century.
items.body: It was not published until the 18th century and remained dismissed until the twentieth. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: Amongst Men is a four-part Argentine crime thriller television miniseries based on the eponymous novel by Germán Maggiori.
items.body: It was released on HBO Max on 26 September 2021. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Two Much is a 1995 romantic screwball comedy film based on Donald Westlake's novel of the same name, and is also a remake of the 1984 French comedy film Le Jumeau.
items.body: Directed by Fernando Trueba, Two Much stars Antonio Banderas, Melanie Griffith, Daryl Hannah, and Danny Aiello. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.body: The books are considered classics of Australian children's literature. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
